Identify posterior-odds clusters in sensor-by-time BGAMM predictions

Source: R/analyse_bgam_spatiotemporal.R
analyse_bgam_spatiotemporal.Rd

Uses an existing univariate `brmsfit` object and explicit prediction grids. When sensor adjacency is omitted, an approximate adjacency graph is inferred from projected sensor coordinates. An explicitly supplied physical sensor topology is preferable for confirmatory analyses.

Usage

analyse_bgam_spatiotemporal(
  model,
  newdata,
  sensor_adjacency = NULL,
  newdata_b = NULL,
  sensor_id = "sensor",
  time_id = "time",
  spatial_id = c("xproj", "yproj"),
  null_value = 0,
  rope = 0,
  threshold = 10,
  threshold_type = c("both", "above", "below"),
  credible_interval = 0.95,
  draw_ids = NULL,
  chunk_size = 256L,
  re_formula = NA,
  max_gap = NULL,
  adjacency_k = 4L,
  adjacency_distance_factor = 1.8,
  odds_mode = "directional_rope"
)

Arguments

model

Fitted univariate `brmsfit` model.

newdata

Data frame containing exactly one row per sensor and time. Additional model predictor columns, including grouping factors, must be present as required by `brms::posterior_epred()`.

sensor_adjacency

Named adjacency matrix, two-column sensor edge list, or `NULL` (default) to infer adjacency from projected sensor positions.

newdata_b

Optional second condition grid with exactly the same rows and sensor/time coordinates as `newdata`. Inference then concerns A - B.

sensor_id

Name of the electrode identifier column.

time_id

Name of the time coordinate column.

spatial_id

Names of two projected coordinate columns (for plotting).

null_value

Null value for the expected outcome or contrast.

rope

Nonnegative half-width of a fixed ROPE around `null_value`.

threshold

Posterior odds threshold, strictly greater than one.

threshold_type

Whether to detect above/below/both directions.

credible_interval

Width of equal-tailed posterior intervals.

draw_ids

Optional posterior draw indices. When omitted, use all draws. Explicitly supplying indices ensures pairing across conditions and chunks.

chunk_size

Number of sensor-time locations processed at once.

re_formula

`NA` for population-level predictions (default), `NULL` to include fitted group-level deviations.

max_gap

Optional `list(time = ...)` passed to `find_clusters_nd()`.

adjacency_k

Number of nearest neighbors considered when adjacency is generated automatically.

adjacency_distance_factor

Maximum auto-generated edge length relative to the median nearest-neighbor distance. Set to `NULL` to disable distance pruning.

odds_mode

Posterior-odds inference strategy. The default, `"directional_rope"`, computes independent continuous posterior odds for effects above and below the ROPE. These odds are thresholded separately to identify positive and negative clusters. `"legacy_one_sided"` reproduces the historical capped one-sided odds. `"legacy_directional"` and `"spatiotemporal"` are retained for backward compatibility.

Value

List with `predictions`, `cluster_summary`, `cluster_membership`, `model`, `sensor_adjacency`, `adjacency_source`, and metadata.

See also

[make_sensor_adjacency()], [plot_sensor_adjacency()]
